title: Software Refactoring Research with Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.14027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Code refactoring is the improvement of code internally without changing the external functionalities of the program. Due to its exhaustive nature, developers often avoid manually refactoring code. Researchers have since looked into utilizing LLMs to automate the task of refactoring. Aim and Method: Despite the promising results, there is a lack of clear un- derstanding of LLMs' effectiveness in automated refactoring. Result: From our literature review we found that: (i) there are various tools that different studies use to enhance and study LLM-driving refactoring, with tools that were used to detect code smells, generate code bases, and compare refactoring outcomes. (ii) Various datasets were collected from multiple open- source projects in multiple programming languages for analysis. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的软件重构研究：系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 背景：代码重构是在不改变程序外部功能的前提下改进代码内部结构。由于其繁琐耗时的特性，开发人员通常避免手动重构代码。因此，研究人员开始研究利用大语言模型（LLM）来自动化重构任务。目标与方法：尽管已有结果令人期待，但目前对大语言模型在自动化重构中的有效性仍缺乏清晰的认识。结果：通过我们的文献综述发现：(i) 不同的研究使用了各种工具来增强和研究由大语言模型驱动的重构，这些工具被用于检测代码坏味道、生成代码库以及比较重构结果。(ii) 从多个开源项目中收集了涵盖多种编程语言的各种数据集进行分析，这些平台包括GitHub、Apache和F-Droid，其中收集和分析最多的编程语言是Java。(iii) 单次提示、少样本提示……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述梳理了大语言模型在软件重构自动化领域的研究现状，总结了相关工具、数据集来源与提示策略等关键发现。
en_tdlr: This systematic literature review synthesizes the state of research on LLM-driven software refactoring, summarizing key findings on tools, datasets, and prompting strategies.
